summary: Sporting News Betting promotes sportsbook welcome bonuses for Monday Night Football in Week 15, Eagles vs. Seahawks in Seattle, claiming new users can get over $5,000 in total offers from six sportsbooks using exclusive promo codes and links. It details each operator's terms, such as first-bet safety nets, bonus bets and deposit matches. It closes with context on both teams' losing streaks and playoff stakes.
one_line: Guide to promo codes and welcome bonuses from six sportsbooks for Eagles vs. Seahawks Monday Night Football, plus a preview of both teams' losing streaks.
key_facts: Monday Night Football closes out NFL Week 15 with the Eagles vs. Seahawks in Seattle, both teams trying to snap losing streaks.
Using the article's codes and links at Bet365, BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars Sportsbook, DraftKings and FanDuel, new users can claim more than $5,000 in bonuses.
Bet365 code TSNCO offers either a First Bet Safety Net up to $1,000 or Bet $5, Get $150 in bonus bets; code VATSN is for Virginia and NJTSN for New Jersey.
BetMGM code SPORTSPICK gives a first bet offer up to $1,500 in bonus bets, requiring a minimum $10 deposit; a losing first bet is refunded as bonus bets.
BetRivers code SPORTSRIV gives a Second Chance Bet of up to $100 (AZ, IA, OH, WV), $250 (CO, NJ) or $500 (IL, IN, LA, MD, MI, PA, VA) depending on state.
Caesars Sportsbook code NEWS1000 offers a First Bet bonus up to $1,000 with a $10 minimum deposit, refunded as a single bonus bet if the first bet loses.
DraftKings offers up to $1,200 in welcome offers: $50 bonus bet for a $5 deposit, $150 in bonus bets for a $5 bet, and a 20% first deposit match up to $1,000.
The maximum DraftKings $1,000 deposit match requires depositing $5,000 and has a 25x playthrough requirement.
FanDuel gives $150 in bonus bets if a new user's $5 moneyline bet wins; the article suggests the favored Eagles.
The Eagles are 10-3 on a two-game losing streak, second in the NFC East behind the Cowboys, who are also 10-3 and hold the tiebreaker on divisional record.
The Eagles lost to the Jets in Week 6 (their first loss), won five straight over teams including the Dolphins, Cowboys and Chiefs, then lost blowouts to the 49ers and Cowboys.
The Seahawks have lost four straight and sit four games behind the 49ers in the NFC West but still have a shot at a wild card spot.
Seattle's remaining schedule includes winnable games against the Titans, Steelers and Cardinals.
